historical_references.context: According to Hindu mythology, Phalguni is the name of the demon king Hiranyakasipu's sister, who was a demoness. She was the mother of Holika, another demon. Holika, who was immune to fire, was tasked with killing her nephew, Prahlada, who was a devotee of Lord Vishnu. However, in the end, it was Holika who was burnt to ashes, and Prahlada was saved. This legend is celebrated as 'Holika Dahan' or 'Chhoti Holi' on the eve of Holi.
